data.why: The repo bundles a realistic 96-well long-format plate export with deliberately injected issues (missing values, mixed date formats, fuzzy header 'Anlyst', inconsistent case/spacing) that is loadable either via the in-app 'Load sample plate export' button or by uploading the same file manually.

goals: upload a raw instrument/plate-reader export and see its layout (long vs grid) detected automatically
review and confirm the proposed column-to-canonical-schema mapping, correcting any low-confidence matches
inspect QC flags such as outliers, replicate disagreement, overflow/negative readings, and control sanity on a plate heatmap
fit a standard curve and back-calculate sample concentrations with confidence intervals
monitor control runs over time with a Levey-Jennings chart and Westgard rule violations
get a fitness verdict (PASS/REVIEW/FAIL) on whether the dataset is safe to model on, and export the cleaned dataset plus a full audit trail

review.summary: The tree follows LabBridge's six-step wizard faithfully, from messy export to mapping, QC flags, scientific validation, verdict and audited export, with precise labels and screens that hold up on inspection. It needs small fixes before filing: add the missing fitness-verdict feature, correct the 'one-of' branch types on the first two tasks, and move the crash test out of the mapping workflow.
